attchmntText: HP Adhesives Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: HP Adhesives Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 5th November 2026. The publication appeared in Active Times and Prathakal on 7th November 2026. The financial statements are available on the company website. This announcement serves as an intimation to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited under SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Un-Audited financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
HP Adhesives Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
